observations.seen: Frame 2 has a warm low sun behind the arch and long raking shadows, which matches golden hour. In frames 1 and 4 the building facades are evenly overlit pale yellow-white with little directional falloff, so the scene reads as flat midday.

Frame 2 shows long building shadows across the cobbles. The capsule pedestrians in frames 1 and 4 cast no visible contact shadow and look like they float. The tram has only a faint dark band under the chassis.
The tram's red paint is glossy but shows blotchy, baked-looking highlights rather than coherent sky or environment reflections. The tram windows show no reflection of the surroundings.

The townhouses are box facades with stretched window textures and flat red roof planes. The far town in frame 3 is a flat cutout above a cloud sea. The arch, clock tower, elevated looping track, and cobble plaza give the world identity.
Frame 3 has a sun glow and haze over the cloud sea, and frame 2 has distance haze toward the arch. The haze is milky and lifts the whole frame instead of building depth gradually over 30 to 180 m.

The tram's surface looks like a noisy scanned or generated texture with smeared detail. The building walls are uniform matte with painted-on windows. The cobble ground repeats visibly, and the track sleepers are plain brown blocks.

Fidelity is mixed within the same shot. Detailed figures and a scanned-looking tram and clock tower sit next to untextured capsule-and-sphere placeholder people (blue, teal, orange, pink) and simple sphere bushes.

In chase frames 2 and 3 the tram sits centered at about 10 to 12% of the frame, slightly under the 15 to 25% target. Five HUD panels occupy the corners and the bottom strip and crowd the playfield. The side shots in frames 1 and 4 are flat, frontal arrangements.

The chase camera sits behind and above the tram at a moderate FOV that reads close to 60. The side station shots use a high, static angle. A catenary wire cuts straight through the top of frames 2 and 3.

A vignette and a warm grade are present, and the bottom edges are slightly blurred in frames 1 and 4. The grade washes highlights toward cream and lacks charcoal depth in the shadows, so the result is hazy instead of cinematic film contrast.

The navy panels with cream borders are consistent and readable, and the lean meter is clear. The HUD is dense: an objective box, a stats box, a passenger list, and a full-width control bar together cover a large share of the screen.
